summary: A 27-year-old woman fell ~400 ft near Snowmass Lake in the Maroon Bells-Snowmass Wilderness, suffering an open leg fracture and a head injury; three bystanders tended to her until ~20 Mountain Rescue Aspen responders arrived; she was carried ~0.5 mi to a helicopter landing zone and CareFlight of the Rockies flew her to Aspen Valley Hospital ~8:30 p.m. Tuesday with non-life-threatening injuries.
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen; CareFlight of the Rockies
